catalogue: Australian advanced external cladding and facade drawing objects

ncc_references.relationship: External-wall weatherproofing context only; this catalogue identifies drawable parts, not a deemed-to-satisfy facade design.

objects.name: ventilated rainscreen facade assembly
objects.definition: An external cladding arrangement where panels or boards sit on an offset support system with a drained and ventilated cavity behind the weathering face.
functions: Provide a cavity for drainage and drying
Carry panel loads back to the wall structure

cad.pattern: Panel fields offset from the wall on rails or battens
cad.placement: Outside the weather barrier and structural wall
cad.opening: Panels, rails and cavity return around openings
cad.load: Outer cladding load carried by facade supports

notes: Use as a drawing family. Product-specific fire, wind and weatherproofing evidence must remain separate.

objects.name: open-jointed rainscreen facade assembly
objects.definition: A rainscreen facade where deliberate visible gaps remain between panels and the cavity, membrane, flashings and baffles behind them manage water and air movement.
functions: Allow pressure and drainage behaviour defined by the selected system
Keep the rear weather-control layer explicit

cad.pattern: Panel grid with visible gaps and hidden backing elements
cad.placement: At the external face of a ventilated rainscreen
cad.opening: Joint pattern turns around openings or stops at trims

notes: The open gap is drawn as geometry, not as missing detail.

objects.name: rail-and-bracket facade support system
objects.definition: A support subframe of rails, brackets, anchors and isolation pieces that spaces facade panels away from the backing wall and transfers their actions to structure.
functions: Transfer wind and self-weight actions to the wall

cad.pattern: Repeated rail grid with bracket points aligned to panel layout
cad.placement: Between structural backing and facade panels
cad.opening: Rails trim and return around openings

notes: Do not infer engineering capacity from the drawn bracket count.

objects.name: metal cassette facade assembly
objects.definition: A facade assembly using folded metal tray or cassette panels fixed to rails, cleats or brackets with expressed, sealed or drained joints.
functions: Form a flat or folded metal weathering face
Coordinate returns, stiffeners and panel joints

cad.pattern: Rectangular or custom cassette grid on a support frame
cad.placement: Outside a facade support system
cad.opening: Cassette modules and returns frame openings
cad.load: Panel loads transferred through cassette fixings

notes: A cassette is a formed panel geometry; material and core type remain separate choices.

objects.name: composite metal panel facade assembly
objects.definition: A facade assembly using laminated metal-faced panels, commonly routed, folded or captured into cassette, tray or flat-sheet arrangements.
functions: Provide a flat panel facade face
Coordinate folded returns and edge details
Keep composite-panel material evidence separate from the support geometry

cad.pattern: Composite panel modules fixed flat or folded into trays
cad.placement: As the visible face of a metal cassette or panel facade
cad.opening: Routed or cut panels return around openings where detailed

notes: ABCB guidance treats composite or laminated panels differently from solid metal sheet pathways; keep compliance evidence outside the drawing class.

objects.name: insulated sandwich panel wall assembly
objects.definition: A wall assembly made from factory-bonded insulated panels with metal skins, an insulation core, edge joints, fasteners, seals and flashings.
functions: Combine cladding face and insulated panel body
Span between supports where the selected product permits

cad.pattern: Large panels running horizontally or vertically between supports
cad.placement: At the external wall plane or as a self-supporting panel wall as documented
cad.opening: Cut openings need product-specific support and flashing
cad.load: Panel action only where selected product allows

notes: Do not split the core from skins unless the tool needs an exploded or section view.

objects.name: EIFS insulated render wall system
objects.definition: An external insulated finish system made from insulation boards or panels with adhesive or mechanical fixings, reinforced base coat, trims and a textured finish coat.
functions: Create shaped returns, beads and terminations

cad.pattern: Continuous insulated fields with beads, joints and opening returns
cad.placement: Outside framing, masonry or sheathing as the selected system allows
cad.opening: Insulation and render return to framed openings with reinforced corners
cad.load: Non-structural cladding finish unless designed otherwise

notes: Existing masonry render objects cover solid render; this object is for external insulation-plus-render systems.

objects.name: cavity EIFS wall system
objects.definition: An insulated render system installed over battens or another spacer arrangement so a drainage cavity remains behind the insulation and rendered face.
functions: Combine an insulated rendered face with a drained cavity
Separate rear water control from the outer finish
Create a support grid for insulation panels

cad.pattern: Rendered insulation panels fixed over a spaced cavity grid
cad.placement: Outside weather barrier and battens
cad.opening: Cavity and insulation return around openings
cad.load: Outer finish carried through cavity supports

objects.name: terracotta rainscreen facade assembly
objects.definition: A ventilated facade assembly using fired-clay terracotta tiles, panels or baguettes supported on rails, clips and gaskets.
functions: Create a repeated panel or baguette pattern
Transfer terracotta units to a rail support system

cad.pattern: Repeated terracotta units on horizontal or vertical rails
cad.placement: On a ventilated facade support system
cad.opening: Units stop or return around openings with cut panels where permitted
cad.load: Terracotta unit support through clips and rails

objects.name: vinyl or uPVC board cladding assembly
objects.definition: A lightweight external cladding assembly using interlocking vinyl or uPVC boards with starter strips, channels, corner posts and movement clearances.
functions: Form a lightweight board-format wall face
Use interlocks and trims to locate boards
Allow product movement at slots, channels and ends

cad.pattern: Interlocked board courses or runs with proprietary edge trims
cad.placement: Outside the wall support system
cad.opening: Boards cut into J-channels and opening trims

objects.name: wood-plastic composite board cladding assembly
objects.definition: An external cladding assembly using wood-plastic composite boards fixed with clips, screws or trims over a support grid.
functions: Form a composite board wall face
Use clip or face-fix methods defined by the selected product

cad.pattern: Repeated composite boards over battens or rails
cad.placement: At the external wall face
cad.opening: Boards and trims frame openings

objects.name: continuous external insulation wall layer
objects.definition: A wall layer where rigid insulation boards are placed continuously outside the structural framing or substrate and behind the cladding support or finish system.
functions: Create a drawing host for long fixings, washers and rail supports

cad.pattern: Continuous board fields interrupted by openings, supports and edges
cad.placement: Outside the structural wall and behind the selected cladding plane
cad.opening: Boards return, stop or are trimmed around openings
cad.load: Insulation layer only; cladding loads need documented supports

notes: Reuse thermal-catalog board material families for EPS, XPS, PIR and similar products.

objects.name: rainscreen facade panel
objects.definition: A discrete flat, profiled or textured panel used as one visible module in a rainscreen facade.
functions: Attach to clips, rails or direct fasteners

cad.pattern: Repeated panel grid
cad.placement: On the outer face of a rainscreen support system
cad.opening: Cut or scheduled around openings
cad.load: Facade panel self-weight and wind actions through fixings

objects.name: rainscreen panel joint
objects.definition: The controlled gap or interface line between adjacent rainscreen panels, including any backing strip, baffle, seal or gasket required by the selected system.
functions: Coordinate water, air and movement at the panel interface

cad.pattern: Continuous grid lines between facade panels
cad.placement: Between adjacent panel edges
cad.opening: The joint itself is a controlled gap

objects.name: open rainscreen joint
objects.definition: A visible unsealed gap between rainscreen panels that remains deliberately open while hidden backing details manage weathering.
functions: Allow drainage or ventilation behaviour defined by the system
Expose the need for a rear weather-control layer

cad.pattern: Visible continuous dark or recessed gap lines
cad.placement: Between open-jointed facade panels
cad.opening: Remains open in the visible model

objects.name: rainscreen joint baffle
objects.definition: A hidden profile or strip placed behind an open facade joint to interrupt water entry, shadow the backing layer or form part of a pressure-managed joint.
functions: Reduce direct water path behind the panel face
Provide a dark shadow line in the model

cad.pattern: Continuous hidden strip behind open joint lines
cad.placement: Behind vertical or horizontal open joints
cad.opening: Sits behind the gap without filling it

objects.name: facade support bracket
objects.definition: A discrete metal bracket fixed to backing structure to hold a facade rail or panel support away from the wall.
functions: Transfer facade loads to backing structure
Provide adjustment or tolerance where the system allows

cad.pattern: Repeated discrete points along facade rail lines
cad.placement: Between backing wall and carrier rail

objects.name: facade stand-off spacer
objects.definition: A spacer or stand-off component that holds a rail, clip or panel fixing a controlled distance away from the backing wall or support.

cad.pattern: Discrete spacers at fastener or bracket points
cad.placement: Between support components and backing
cad.load: Local spacing and load-transfer role where designed

objects.name: facade thermal isolation pad
objects.definition: A small pad or washer placed at a bracket or fixing interface to reduce direct thermal bridging and separate dissimilar materials.
functions: Provide local isolation at a bracket
Maintain drawing visibility of thermal break points

cad.pattern: One pad at selected bracket or fastener interfaces
cad.placement: Between metal bracket and backing or rail
cad.opening: Fastener holes pass through pad

objects.name: vertical facade carrier rail
objects.definition: A vertical metal rail that receives panel clips, screws, hooks or cassette fixings in a facade support system.

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical rails at panel support centres
cad.placement: In the facade cavity outside the backing wall
cad.opening: Rail segments stop, trim or bridge around openings as designed

objects.name: horizontal facade rail
objects.definition: A horizontal metal rail used to support, hook, clip or align facade panels or terracotta units.
functions: Carry panel dead load or restraint where designed

cad.pattern: Repeated horizontal rails at panel course lines
cad.placement: Within the facade support cavity
cad.opening: Stops and returns at openings

objects.name: facade rail splice plate
objects.definition: A connector plate or insert used to join two facade rail lengths while maintaining alignment and any required movement gap.

cad.pattern: Discrete connector at rail end joints
cad.placement: At rail splices

objects.name: facade fixed-point connection
objects.definition: A selected facade rail, bracket or panel connection that restrains movement in the nominated direction and acts as the datum for expansion or tolerance.
functions: Hold a panel or rail at a fixed location
Separate fixed restraint from sliding restraint

cad.pattern: One or more datum points per rail or panel module
cad.placement: At documented rail or panel fixing points

objects.name: facade sliding-point connection
objects.definition: A facade connection detailed with a slot, clearance or compatible fastener condition so the connected panel or rail can move in a nominated direction.
functions: Restrain the component in other directions
Avoid treating every fixing as a rigid point

cad.pattern: Repeated sliding fixings away from fixed datum points
cad.placement: At documented rail or panel fixing points
cad.opening: Slotted hole remains explicit if detailed

objects.name: facade panel clip
objects.definition: A small metal or proprietary connector that engages a facade panel edge, kerf, groove or back fixing and attaches it to a rail or bracket.
functions: Provide concealed or expressed panel restraint
Allow replacement sequence where the system permits

cad.pattern: Discrete clips along panel edges or backs
cad.placement: Between panel and rail

objects.name: facade hook plate
objects.definition: A plate or bracket shaped to hook a facade panel, cassette or terracotta unit onto a rail or matching receiver.
functions: Transfer dead load to a rail

cad.pattern: Discrete hook plates at scheduled panel support points
cad.placement: Between panel and rail receiver

objects.name: metal cassette tray panel
objects.definition: A folded metal panel module with returns or tray edges that create depth and fixing zones behind the visible face.
functions: Create returned edges for fixing and stiffness

cad.pattern: Repeated cassette panel modules
cad.placement: At the visible face of a cassette facade
cad.opening: Cut modules around openings only where scheduled

objects.name: cassette return fold
objects.definition: The folded edge leg of a cassette or routed panel that turns back from the visible face to create depth, stiffness or a fixing edge.
materials: folded composite panel skin where selected

cad.pattern: Continuous folded legs around cassette edges
cad.placement: At the perimeter of a cassette tray
cad.opening: Defines cassette edge geometry
cad.load: Panel edge stiffness and fixing role

objects.name: cassette panel stiffener
objects.definition: A concealed bar, angle or bonded member fixed to the back of a cassette panel to limit panel deflection or oil-canning as documented.
functions: Create a hidden drawing element for large panels

cad.pattern: Concealed linear stiffeners on back of selected panels
cad.placement: Behind the cassette face

objects.name: cassette fixing cleat
objects.definition: A small angle, plate or proprietary connector fixed to a cassette return or rail to support, locate or restrain the cassette module.
functions: Conceal or organise panel fixing points

cad.pattern: Discrete cleats at panel support and restraint points
cad.placement: Between cassette tray and rail or support

objects.name: aluminium composite panel
objects.definition: A laminated flat panel with aluminium skins bonded to a core, used as a facade sheet or routed cassette material where the selected product is accepted.
functions: Allow routing, folding or sheet fixing where permitted

cad.pattern: Flat sheet modules or routed cassette blanks
cad.placement: As the panel material in a composite metal panel facade
cad.opening: Cut edges and penetrations remain explicit

notes: Material naming does not establish compliance or fire classification.

objects.name: solid metal facade plate
objects.definition: A solid metal plate or sheet panel used as a facade module without a bonded non-metal core.
functions: Provide a solid metal weathering face
Create folded, flat or mechanically fixed panel modules
Separate solid metal from laminated composite panels

cad.pattern: Panel modules, sheets or cassettes from solid metal
cad.placement: At the external metal facade face
cad.opening: Cut or folded around openings where detailed

objects.name: metal honeycomb facade panel
objects.definition: A composite facade panel with metal face sheets bonded to a honeycomb core, used where a selected product system documents the support and edge details.
functions: Reduce panel weight for a given depth
Create product-specific edge and fixing details

cad.pattern: Flat honeycomb panel modules on rails or cassettes
cad.placement: At the facade panel plane
cad.opening: Cut edges need selected-product closures

objects.name: sandwich panel outer metal skin
objects.definition: The external metal sheet face of an insulated sandwich wall panel, including its finish, profile and weather-exposed surface.

cad.pattern: Continuous face sheet as part of each sandwich panel
cad.placement: Outside face of the insulated panel
cad.opening: Cut around openings with exposed-core protection

objects.name: sandwich panel inner metal liner
objects.definition: The internal metal sheet face of an insulated sandwich wall panel, visible or concealed on the inside of the panel assembly.
functions: Provide the inner finish or backing face

cad.pattern: Continuous inner sheet as part of each sandwich panel
cad.placement: Inside face of the insulated panel
cad.opening: Cut and sealed around openings or services

objects.name: sandwich panel insulation core
objects.definition: The factory-bonded insulation body between the inner and outer skins of an insulated sandwich panel.
functions: Bond the inner and outer skins into one panel
Remain protected at cut edges and joints

cad.pattern: Core volume inside each sandwich panel
cad.placement: Between the two metal skins
cad.opening: Core is exposed by cuts and must be detailed
cad.load: Core role depends on selected product

objects.name: sandwich panel side-lap joint
objects.definition: The shaped longitudinal edge joint where adjacent sandwich panels interlock, overlap, seal or fasten together.
functions: Weather and align the side joint
Provide a fastener and seal location

cad.pattern: Continuous joint along each long panel edge
cad.placement: Between adjacent sandwich panels
cad.opening: Panel side joint remains explicit

objects.name: sandwich panel fastener and sealing washer
objects.definition: A screw or other fastener with a sealing washer used to fix insulated sandwich panels to supports or flashings.
functions: Compress a weather seal at the fixing head

cad.pattern: Repeated fastener points along support lines and flashings
cad.placement: Through panel skin into support

objects.name: EIFS insulation panel
objects.definition: A rigid insulation board or panel forming the body of an external insulated render system before mesh, base coat and finish are applied.
functions: Receive fixings and reinforced render layers

cad.pattern: Board fields staggered or jointed as selected by the system
cad.placement: Behind reinforced render layers
cad.opening: Returns and cut boards around openings

objects.name: EIFS adhesive bed
objects.definition: A compatible adhesive layer, beads or patches used to bond EIFS insulation panels to the prepared backing where the selected system permits adhesive fixing.
functions: Define adhesive-only or combined fixing layouts

cad.pattern: Continuous, ribbon, dab or documented adhesive fields behind boards
cad.placement: Between backing wall and EIFS insulation panel
cad.opening: Adhesive returns or stops at openings as detailed

objects.name: EIFS mechanical fixing washer
objects.definition: A disc, washer or fixing head used with a screw or anchor to mechanically hold EIFS insulation panels to the supporting wall.
functions: Hold panels until and after render build-up
Create repeated visible points in section or exploded views

cad.pattern: Repeated fixing discs through insulation boards
cad.placement: Through EIFS insulation into backing or framing

objects.name: EIFS reinforced base coat
objects.definition: The render-like base layer applied over EIFS insulation panels to embed reinforcing mesh and prepare the surface for finish coats.
functions: Bridge board joints within system limits

cad.pattern: Continuous coat over EIFS insulation fields
cad.placement: Over insulation panels and under finish coats
cad.opening: Returns and reinforced corners at openings
cad.load: Render base and mesh embedment role

objects.name: EIFS reinforcing mesh
objects.definition: A fabric mesh embedded in the EIFS base coat across field areas, corners, joints and local stress points.
functions: Control cracking at board joints and corners

cad.pattern: Full mesh fields with laps and local patches
cad.placement: Embedded in the EIFS base coat
cad.opening: Cut and patched around openings

objects.name: EIFS diagonal opening mesh patch
objects.definition: A local diagonal reinforcing mesh patch embedded at the corner of an EIFS opening or other stress concentration.
functions: Show local mesh not visible in normal elevation
Separate local stress patches from full-field mesh

cad.pattern: Diagonal local patches at opening corners
cad.placement: Embedded over base mesh at window, door or penetration corners
cad.opening: Placed at opening arrises

objects.name: EIFS starter track
objects.definition: A base profile or rail that supports, aligns or terminates the bottom edge of EIFS insulation panels and render build-up.
functions: Protect or drain the base edge

cad.pattern: Continuous horizontal base profile
cad.placement: At the base of EIFS wall fields

objects.name: EIFS corner bead
objects.definition: A corner profile embedded in EIFS base coat and finish to form, protect or reinforce an external rendered arris.
functions: Provide mesh wings or profile reinforcement

cad.pattern: Continuous profile at external EIFS arrises
cad.placement: At corners and opening returns
cad.opening: Commonly frames opening arrises

objects.name: EIFS control joint
objects.definition: A deliberate separation line through EIFS finish layers that accommodates movement or divides wall fields according to the selected system.
functions: Create a clear drawing line for joint layout

cad.pattern: Continuous joint lines dividing EIFS fields
cad.placement: At documented movement or control-joint lines
cad.opening: Creates an actual separation line

objects.name: EIFS textured finish coat
objects.definition: The outer coloured or textured coating applied over the EIFS base coat to form the visible rendered facade surface.

cad.pattern: Continuous visible finish fields
cad.placement: Over EIFS base coat
cad.opening: Returns to beads, stops and openings

objects.name: vinyl cladding board
objects.definition: A long uPVC or vinyl cladding board with a visible face, lock edge and fixing hem or slot as part of a board cladding system.
functions: Move within fixing slots and trims

cad.pattern: Repeated interlocking boards
cad.placement: Across the vinyl cladding field
cad.opening: Cut into channels at openings

objects.name: vinyl cladding nail hem
objects.definition: The fixing flange along a vinyl board or accessory containing slots or holes for nails or screws while allowing board movement.
functions: Hide behind the next board or trim

cad.pattern: Continuous fixing flange with repeated slots
cad.placement: Along the hidden edge of a vinyl board
cad.opening: Slots remain visible in detail views

objects.name: vinyl cladding lock edge
objects.definition: The shaped edge of a vinyl board that snaps, hooks or laps into the matching edge of the adjacent board.
functions: Create the board lap or engagement

cad.pattern: Continuous interlock along each board
cad.placement: At board-to-board engagement line

objects.name: vinyl cladding starter strip
objects.definition: A base profile fixed to the wall to receive and align the first course of vinyl cladding boards.

cad.pattern: Continuous horizontal starter profile
cad.placement: At the base of vinyl cladding fields

objects.name: vinyl cladding J-channel
objects.definition: A J-shaped trim profile that receives cut ends or edges of vinyl cladding boards at openings, sides, soffits or terminations.
functions: Allow movement clearance inside the channel

cad.pattern: Continuous receiver trim around openings and terminations
cad.placement: At vinyl board edges
cad.opening: Frames openings and receives board ends

objects.name: vinyl cladding corner post
objects.definition: A vertical vinyl profile at an external or internal corner that receives cladding board ends from adjacent wall faces.
functions: Receive board ends from two faces
Maintain movement clearance at the corner

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical post at wall corners
cad.placement: At external or internal corners of vinyl cladding
cad.opening: Receives board ends from both sides

objects.name: WPC cladding board
objects.definition: A long wood-plastic composite board used as a visible cladding member with face-fix, concealed-clip or proprietary trim details.
functions: Attach to clips, battens or rails

cad.pattern: Repeated boards over supports
cad.placement: At the visible WPC cladding face
cad.opening: Cut and trimmed around openings

objects.name: WPC cladding hidden clip
objects.definition: A concealed metal or plastic clip that engages a WPC board groove and fixes the board to its support while maintaining a gap.

cad.pattern: Discrete clips at each support crossing
cad.placement: Between grooved WPC board and support batten or rail

objects.name: WPC starter or end clip
objects.definition: A special clip used to start, finish or restrain the first or last WPC cladding board in a field.
functions: Start or terminate a board field
Create a clean hidden fixing at boundaries

cad.pattern: Discrete clips along start and finish lines
cad.placement: At the first or last WPC board edge

objects.name: terracotta facade tile or panel
objects.definition: A fired-clay facade tile or panel module hung, clipped or otherwise supported on a terracotta rainscreen support system.
functions: Form the visible terracotta facade face

cad.pattern: Repeated terracotta panel modules
cad.placement: On the terracotta facade rail system
cad.opening: Cut panels or special returns frame openings

objects.name: terracotta baguette
objects.definition: A long hollow or solid terracotta member used as a sunscreen, screen, louvre or decorative linear element in a facade.
functions: Attach to end supports or carrier rails

cad.pattern: Repeated linear ceramic members at selected spacing
cad.placement: In front of or within the facade plane
cad.opening: May screen openings without closing them

objects.name: terracotta facade clip
objects.definition: A metal clip or holder that supports or restrains a terracotta facade tile, panel or baguette on its carrier rail.

cad.pattern: Discrete clips at terracotta support points
cad.placement: Between terracotta unit and rail

objects.name: facade cavity barrier
objects.definition: A horizontal, vertical or perimeter barrier installed in a facade cavity to subdivide concealed spaces according to a selected fire or compartmentation detail.
functions: Create a drawable object at slab edges, openings or junctions

cad.pattern: Continuous barrier lines at compartment, floor, opening or junction positions
cad.placement: Across the facade cavity
cad.opening: May turn around openings

notes: This records drawable location and parts only; fire performance is system evidence.

objects.name: open-state intumescent facade cavity barrier
objects.definition: A ventilating cavity barrier that leaves an air path in normal conditions and uses an intumescent component to close the opening when activated by fire.
functions: Permit cavity ventilation in normal service
Close or restrict the cavity when the intumescent activates
Show the difference between open and closed barrier states

cad.pattern: Continuous ventilating barrier with explicit open gap
cad.placement: Across ventilated facade cavities at documented lines
cad.opening: Normal-state opening remains visible in section

notes: Model normal and activated states separately if sequencing or fire diagrams are needed.

objects.name: external insulation long screw
objects.definition: A long screw or fastener that passes through external insulation to hold battens, rails, washers or cladding supports back to the structure.
functions: Represent visible thermal-bridge points in detail drawings

cad.pattern: Repeated fasteners through insulation at support lines
cad.placement: Through external insulation into structural backing

objects.name: external insulation washer plate
objects.definition: A disc, plate or washer that spreads fastener load over rigid external insulation board or a facade support interface.
functions: Make fixing points visible in sections or exploded views

cad.pattern: Repeated washer plates at board or rail fixing points
cad.placement: On the outer face of external insulation or under support members
